title: Cultural Dimensions of Artificial Intelligence Adoption: Empirical Insights for Wave 1 from a Multinational Longitudinal Pilot Study
reasoning: The study explicitly incorporates 'digital ethics' as one of its three primary theoretical frameworks and empirically measures 'ethical acceptability' and 'ethical judgment' of AI as core research variables. It evaluates how cultural backgrounds mediate ethical perceptions of AI use (e.g., distinguishing between professional pragmatism and academic plagiarism) and dedicates an entire section to 'Ethical Considerations.'
